name: halo-combat-evolved-xbox-turn-25
lines:
أُطلق جهاز Xbox في أمريكا
الشمالية يوم 15 نوفمبر 2001

كانت Halo: Combat Evolved
ضمن ألعاب الإطلاق

أعاد استوديو
هالو ستوديوز (Halo Studios)
بناء الحملة بالكامل

صدرت Halo: Campaign Evolved
في 28 يوليو على Xbox و PC و PS5
credits: لقطات من إعادة البناء · هالو ستوديوز (Halo Studios)
headline:
قبل 25 عامًا
صدرت Halo مع Xbox
label: في مثل هذا اليوم

reel_check.SOURCE primary read: yes: Microsoft Source 15 Nov 2001 (dateline, launch week), Xbox Wire 13 May 2021, Halo Waypoint, Microsoft Source 8 Apr 2002, Xbox Wire 23 Jul 2026, Steam 2806050; gate 8 Nov 2026 in the story file
reel_check.SOURCE not already posted: yes: ledger find recorded, 0 other hits (Halo); main session checks Publer 7 days before scheduling
reel_check.SOURCE age: yes: anniversary, dated by 15 Nov 2026 itself, not news
reel_check.ANGLE hook/why now/players/payoff: yes: hook the Chief and 25 years; why now 15 Nov 2026 is the 25th anniversary of the Xbox launch; for players: the remake is out on Xbox, PC and PS5; payoff: Halo Studios rebuilt the campaign, out since 28 Jul
reel_check.STORY TYPE items: yes: anniversary: date 15 Nov 2001 and place from Microsoft Source; launch title per Halo Waypoint; developer Bungie per Microsoft Source 2002; today per Xbox Wire 23 Jul 2026
reel_check.STORY one spoken paragraph: yes: Xbox launched in North America on 15 Nov 2001; Halo: Combat Evolved was a launch game; developed by Bungie; Halo Studios has rebuilt its campaign; Halo: Campaign Evolved out 28 Jul on Xbox, PC, PS5
reel_check.STORY subject before pronoun, no line on: yes: Halo named in line 2 before any pronoun, lines open on أُطلق, كانت, من, أعادت, صدرت
reel_check.STORY release verbs: yes: أُطلق for the console, صدرت for the past dated release, no bare تصل
reel_check.STORY names: yes: بانجي (Bungie) and هالو ستوديوز (Halo Studios) added to names-ar.md as Proposed 8 Nov; Microsoft, Xbox Wire as listed
reel_check.WRITING headline/lines/caption/X/Threads: yes: drafts in the story file; game and news word in the first five words (قبل 25 عامًا صدرت Halo); no hashtags on X; IG ends on #ألعاب #أخبار_الألعاب #Halo #Xbox
reel_check.SOUND footage's own sound: yes: the Available Now trailer's own score from 64.5 s (no speech from 63.5 to 105.9 s), music stem only (music_only), no added effects
reel_check.PICTURE footage first: yes: official Halo: Campaign Evolved trailers on Steam, credited on screen as a remake's footage
reel_check.PICTURE not same as last five: yes: picture: Halo Campaign Evolved, no Halo Reel in the last 7 days
reel_check.PICTURE vertical, nothing graphic: yes: Master Chief, Elite, Hunters and the cast shots chosen from the vertical crop sheet; no gore or kills; shots 96.9 to 103 checked frame by frame at 1 s
reel_check.PICTURE credit: yes: one credit over shots 0 to 6 naming the publisher's studio and the footage
reel_check.CHECKS: yes: what I see: remake footage standing in for the 2001 original (credited); what I hear: the trailer's music
